_comment: Every camera here is `frame`, which solves its own distance from the
subject AABB and therefore cannot miss it. Batch 020 spent five
attempts on one shot proving the alternative (L-62), and the two
shots that need a placed camera say why in their own note.
The tunnel bore and the secret alcove are shot with backdrop 'none':
one is a space you stand INSIDE and the other is a slab 4.2 m up, and
neither is an object standing on a floor (L-63).
